summary: Haney, listed by CalMatters as voting Aye on AB 715 (an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight bill), invited HEAL Palestine's Global Healing children from Gaza to the State Assembly floor in February 2026. CAIR Action endorsed him for the general and Vote for Peace rated him Ally, but his documented record includes no explicit war-crimes condemnation, genocide designation, or call to end U.S. military aid, and his platform addresses no Israel/Palestine policy.
